output.summary: An annual climbing legume originating in southern and central Europe. Its leaves end in coiling tendrils, and each pod holds several green or yellow seeds. Immature seeds are eaten fresh, frozen or canned; mature seeds are dried, while snow and snap pea varieties also have edible tender pods.
output.edibilityNote: Immature seeds are eaten fresh, frozen or canned; mature seeds are dried, and snow and snap pea varieties have edible young pods.
